blogPosts.content:
We’re excited to announce an update to the **Purchase Order (PO) printing feature** in Spacelinx MES!

Previously, when printing a PO, you had to print **all columns** by default. Now, you have the **flexibility to choose exactly what information you want to include** in your printed documents.

### What’s new?

When you click **Print PO**, a new **Print Options dialog** will appear. Here’s what you can do:

- **Select which fields to include:** Part Number, HSN, Manufacturing Part Number, Tax Group, Tax Value, and Tax Amount.
- **Easier readability:** Only include the information you need, making your printed PO cleaner and more focused.
- **Quick and simple:** Just tick the checkboxes and click **Print** — no extra steps required.

### Why this is useful

- Print **custom POs** for different departments or purposes.
- Reduce paper usage by printing only relevant information.
- Make it easier for your team to review and approve POs.

### How to use it

1. Navigate to the **Purchase Orders** section.
2. Click **Print PO** on the PO you want to print.
3. Tick the checkboxes for the fields you want to include.
4. Click **Print**. That’s it — your customized PO will be ready to use.

We hope this update makes handling Purchase Orders even easier for your daily workflow!

Stay tuned for more user-friendly improvements in Spacelinx MES.

blogPosts.content:
SpaceLinx MES (Manufacturing Execution System) is an advanced digital platform designed to streamline aerospace and high-precision manufacturing workflows.  
It bridges the gap between planning and production, ensuring **real-time visibility**, **traceability**, and **process control** across your entire manufacturing lifecycle.

---

## 🚀 What is SpaceLinx MES?

SpaceLinx MES is part of the SpaceLinx Digital Suite — a modular, scalable ecosystem for manufacturing and engineering excellence.  
It integrates multiple domains such as **PLM (Product Lifecycle Management)**, **Procurement**, **Inventory**, and **Production** — enabling teams to operate in a unified environment.

---

## 🧠 Core Capabilities

- **PLM Integration:** Centralized product and parts data management with real-time BOM synchronization.
- **Production Control:** Plan, execute, and track manufacturing processes across multiple work centers.
- **Procurement Automation:** Streamlined purchase orders and supplier collaboration with complete traceability.
- **Inventory Management:** Live stock tracking with location-wise bin management and material movement history.
- **Analytics Dashboard:** KPIs and performance tracking with data-driven insights for operational improvement.

---

## 🧩 Why SpaceLinx?

- Tailored for **Aerospace**, **Defense**, and **Advanced Manufacturing** environments.
- Built with **modular microservices** for flexibility and scalability.
- Provides **real-time synchronization** between engineering, manufacturing, and supply chain systems.
- Powered by a modern stack — React, Node.js, and cloud-native architecture.

---

## 🔒 Digital Transformation Made Easy

SpaceLinx MES is not just a system — it’s a foundation for digital transformation.  
From digital work instructions to automated quality checks, it empowers organizations to achieve **paperless, connected, and efficient manufacturing**.

---

## 💡 What’s Next?

Stay tuned for upcoming posts where we’ll explore:

- **Module Deep Dives** (PLM, Procurement, Manufacturing)
- **Integration Workflows**
- **Deployment and Customization Tips**
- **Security and Role-Based Access**
- **Analytics & Visualization Features**

---

> ✨ _SpaceLinx MES — Building the future of intelligent manufacturing, one process at a time._
